context: M23 o4. Herald Square station mezzanine. Delphine at the token booth with the shoebox in a shopping bag.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: One token. And a minute of your time, if anyone asks.

lines.speaker: npc.token_clerk
lines.text: Thirty-five cents, lady. My time's not for sale. Neither's the minute.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Brannock at the top of the stairs. White sneakers. Rule three.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: The old passage to Penn Station. Half the lights dead. Marcus says the rats own it.
